purpose: Defines runtime acceptance gates for Everkeep evidence delivery through GoreeCloud Mesh without converting backup existence or transport success into recoverability.
required_gates: service credential is minted by GoreeCloud Identity and not self-signed or locally substituted by Everkeep
mesh.evidence.write is the required producer delivery scope
credential lifetime does not exceed 900 seconds
credential kid resolves through the deployed GoreeCloud Identity JWKS endpoint
delivery uses HTTPS except explicit loopback development
delivery refuses HTTP redirects while carrying service identity proof
Mesh base URL contains no user information, query, fragment, or path parameters
envelope contains no backup payloads, archive contents, credentials, or private file/message content
delivery receipt binds to the submitted evidence id
delivery receipt binds to producer_service_id everkeep
expired restore or continuity evidence remains auditable but cannot satisfy current readiness
Mesh transport success never converts backup presence into verified recovery, continuity, or preservation readiness
negative_cases: Everkeep mints, self-signs, or substitutes its own Mesh credential
Identity JWKS or live service-token issuance is unavailable
identity proof outside the approved GoreeCloud Identity profile
another producer identity attempts Everkeep delivery
redirect response from the configured Mesh endpoint
Mesh base URL contains embedded user information, query, fragment, or path parameters
envelope includes raw backup or archive contents
expired restore pass treated as current recovery readiness
deployment_boundary: Everkeep delivery support is implemented, but production acceptance requires a deployed GoreeCloud Identity JWKS endpoint and live Identity-issued everkeep credentials accepted by GoreeCloud Mesh.
